selection_basis: Best measured official pilot score among both arms at +5k/+10k/+15k/+20k.
notes: Pilot checkpoint stores local step=5000. Both pilot arms completed 20000 updates; their final training_summary.json files describe +20000, not the selected +5000 checkpoint. The large selected checkpoint is intentionally omitted from ordinary Git when checkpoint_in_repository=false; its exact SHA-256 is retained.
